sections.text:
[Effects]
Physical and magic damage taken reduces by S+ - XL based on the wind elemental defense value.
Nullifies Blind.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.
When an Ability that causes Blind is used against you.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate against Water enemies increases to L.
